item.title: DROP READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE
item.description: 描述 DROP READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE 语法用于从当前逻辑库中删除读写分离规则。 语法定义 语法 铁路图 DropReadwriteSplittingRule ::= 'DROP' 'READWRITE_SPLITTING' 'RULE' ifExists? ruleName (',' ruleName)* ifExists ::= 'IF' 'EXISTS' ruleName ::= identifier 补充说明 ifExists 子句用于避免 Readwrite-splitting rule not exists 错误。 示例 删除读写分离规则 DROP READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_1; 删除多个读写分离规则 DROP READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE ms_group_1, ms_group_2; 使用 ifExists 子句删除读写分离规则 DROP READWRITE_SPLITTING RULE IF EXISTS ms_group_1; 保留字 DROP、READWRITE_SPLITTING、RULE、IF、EXISTS
